# Arabic on GitHub

> Tested rules for writing Arabic (right-to-left) text on GitHub: Markdown files, issues, pull requests, release
> notes, the repo About text, titles, names, commit messages, discussions and Gists. Almost every rule has a live test on
> the test page.

## Rules

- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): the short, numbered rules for AI tools.
- [Guide (English)](docs/en/guide.md): full guide with examples and links to each test.
- [Guide (Arabic)](docs/ar/guide.md): the same guide in Arabic.
- [README styles (English)](docs/en/styles.md): banners, typing text, badges, cards and layouts tested with Arabic.
- [README styles (Arabic)](docs/ar/styles.md): the same, showing each style live in Arabic.
- [Heritage style (English)](docs/en/heritage.md): a README style from the classical Arabic book, with copy-paste parts.
- [Heritage style (Arabic)](docs/ar/heritage.md): the same, shown live.
- [Glossary](docs/glossary.md): the one Arabic word for each English term, with meaning, other words seen, sources and status.

## Evidence

- [Test page](tests/lab.md): tests T1–T46, each showing the usual way and the fix.
- [Styles test page](tests/styles.md): tests S1–S15, popular README styles and ornaments with Arabic.

## Tools

- [code/check_arabic_md.py](code/check_arabic_md.py): checks Markdown files for the problems in the guide (`<!-- check-arabic: off -->` … `on` around deliberate mistakes).
- [code/page_audit.js](code/page_audit.js): browser-console audit of a github.com page, website and phone-app modes.
- [code/arabic_text.py](code/arabic_text.py): builds the About text, titles and commit messages with the right invisible marks.
- [code/typing_svg.py](code/typing_svg.py): typing-text picture that writes Arabic from the right, Google font built in (`--still`: lines shown at once, no animation).
- [code/arabic_cards.py](code/arabic_cards.py): right-to-left badge, GitHub stats card and quote card pictures.
- [code/ornaments.py](code/ornaments.py): manuscript ornament pictures (shamsa, cartouche, interlace, arabesque, arcade).
- [code/test_tools.py](code/test_tools.py): tests for all the tools.
- [code/make-font-samples.ps1](code/make-font-samples.ps1): draws Arabic text in Windows fonts as pictures.

## Project

- [README.md](README.md): what the repo is, in Arabic and English.
- [templates/README.ar-en.md](templates/README.ar-en.md): a README template in Arabic and English that follows the rules.
- [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md): how to report a problem or add a test.
